review.scope: Only BRIEF-5.md Part C: scifi city, slums and industry, variants 0-7 in summer and winter (48 files). Approved art and references are calibration only.
review.calibration: Good enough to ship beside the approved art. Intentional neon and varied urban footprints are allowed; a wet-street requirement must be visible at native map scale, not merely present as isolated pixels at 8x.
review.prior_review: critic-r5C-0.json does not exist; no earlier passes to preserve.
performed: All six sets inspected in unmarked random 8x2 tiling at native 1x and exact nearest-neighbour 4x (random51); every variant appears twice in each layout.
Every one of the 48 files inspected at exact nearest-neighbour 8x in labelled four-column sheets.
Two additional independent random 8x2 layouts per set inspected at 1x for repeated silhouettes and neighbourhood rhythm.
Summer/winter layouts compared for snow coverage, retained building identity and wet-street readability.

Compared with current-scifi-city.png, current-scifi-slums.png and current-scifi-industry.png; all 24 approved markers; approved round-2 city/slums/industry/suburb/farmland summer and winter variants; paddies summer and winter; and seasonal grass/plains base crops composited with all eight details.

Checked 48x48 size, full opacity, edge streets, buildings contained in cells, seams/framing, repeated stamps, near-duplicates, lighting, pixel clusters, blur/anti-aliasing, halos/fringes, palette compatibility and native-scale legibility.

not_applicable.peak_lattice_or_range: Part C contains no peaks; egg-crate peaks are outside this review.
not_applicable.forest_composite: Part C contains no tree sprites; identical crowns and flat orange autumn are outside this review.
not_applicable.craters_and_ruins: Swiss-cheese craters and classical ruins are outside Part C.

review.technical: All 48 files are 48x48 and fully opaque, with 11-17 colours each. Pixel edges are crisp. No disqualifying anti-aliasing, blur, transparency fringe, reversed light, cut-off building, hard tile join, palette clash or near-duplicate found. The common dark edge ground matches the interior streets; the failures below concern legibility/density and missing readable wet streets, rather than a mismatched border colour.
review.evidence: critic-r5C-1-{city,slums,industry}-{summer,winter}-random51-{1x,4x}.png are the required random-tiling checks; *-files-8x.png show every source file at 8x. Additional random113/random209 layouts, extra-shuffles-1x, brief-references, approved-style, approved-markers, approved-ground and house-style composites are saved with the same prefix.
review.source_integrity: All 48 reviewed PNG hashes still match the first review snapshot. No files in art-drop/out/ were written by this review.

city-summer.observations: Megablock (0), pocket plaza (1), large circular pad (2), planted courtyard/park (3), split buildings (4), tower and low block (5), lower commercial footprint (6), and a diagonal tower cluster (7) make genuinely different neighbourhood silhouettes. Muted structural colours and restrained cyan/magenta fit the approved palette. Roads connect without a contrasting frame.

city-winter.observations: Megablock (0), pocket plaza (1), large circular pad (2), planted courtyard/park (3), split buildings (4), tower and low block (5), lower commercial footprint (6), and a diagonal tower cluster (7) make genuinely different neighbourhood silhouettes. Muted structural colours and restrained cyan/magenta fit the approved palette. Roads connect without a contrasting frame. Roof snow is visible and follows the summer structures, but the broad dark streets remain visually flat/dry; isolated extra pixels do not read as wet reflective paving at 1x or 4x.

slums-summer.observations: Variants 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 retain enough roof mass, patched colour and narrow passages to read as housing. Variants 4, 6 and 7 are too dispersed or fragmented beside the approved container tiles: their silhouettes read as loose clusters of rubble rather than a packed shanty district. Edge ground itself joins correctly.

slums-winter.observations: Variants 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 retain enough roof mass, patched colour and narrow passages to read as housing. Variants 4, 6 and 7 are too dispersed or fragmented beside the approved container tiles: their silhouettes read as loose clusters of rubble rather than a packed shanty district. Edge ground itself joins correctly. Roof snow is visible and follows the summer structures, but the broad dark streets remain visually flat/dry; isolated extra pixels do not read as wet reflective paving at 1x or 4x.

industry-summer.observations: Pipe/refinery plant (0), cooling towers (1), sawtooth-roof hall (2), loading crane (3), tank farm (4), tall utility hall/yard (5), circular processing pool (6), and tanks with a stack (7) are sufficiently distinct. Pipes, rims and left-lit structures survive map zoom; glow accents are controlled.

fail.name: scifi-city@winter-0
fail.problems: Winter roof snow passes, but the required wet, reflective streets do not read at 1x or 4x: the dark street field remains essentially identical to summer (only 2 pixels of the flat summer background change). The few added flecks read as stray dots, not reflective paving. Add deliberate broken horizontal puddle highlights and restrained cyan/magenta reflections immediately below light sources, plus a little slush/track variation; preserve the dark street palette and seamless edge joins. Recheck in the random 8x2 layout at 1x.

fail.name: scifi-slums-4
fail.problems: Too sparse for the round-2 slum rule: the left stack and three separated roof groups enclose a large empty central/right area (57% of the summer tile is the single flat street colour). In the 8x2 map this reads as a few detached rubble/shack islands, not packed stacked housing. Expand and join the housing with readable container fronts, lean-tos and tarps, retaining narrow crooked alleys and the edge street.

fail.name: scifi-slums-6
fail.problems: The four corner-like shack clusters and tiny isolated central magenta roof leave the cell broken into rubble-like islands. At 1x the small grey/green roof fragments lose the rectangular container fronts and stacked housing silhouette visible in the approved slums. Consolidate the fragments into overlapping, clearly outlined shack/container masses with visible wall faces, and narrow the central gaps.

fail.name: scifi-slums-7
fail.problems: The top and bottom housing strips disintegrate into grey/green chips around a broad empty central slot; the isolated central fragments read as debris. At 1x this is a broken rubble stamp rather than a coherent shanty block. Give the two strips continuous, readable roof-and-wall units, stack some housing across the centre, and keep a narrower crooked passage.
